name: muse-agency-management-dashboard
description: Agency Management Dashboard (NestJS Backend + React 19 Vite Frontend) integrated with Infloww OpenAPI v1.4

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const procs = [spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'start:dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }), spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true })]; process.on('SIGINT', () => procs.forEach(p => p.kill()));"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
